scope: Original Base FP8 text-to-image technical and visual sanity review; not a transparency-quality or spatial-accuracy approval
observations: Inspected both freshly rerun native 512x512 RGBA outputs; their SHA-256 values are byte-identical to the original a0c0e168 verification outputs.
The first output depicts a recognizable complete red fox with coherent outlines.
The second depicts a recognizable blue pixel-art dragon with coherent outline and visible pixel structure.
Both have a largely opaque white background despite the transparent-background request. Alpha ranges are 245-255 and 64-255; no fully transparent pixels in either example.
limitations: Two fixed examples do not measure general 8B parity or a human success rate.
Native RGBA format and successful FP8 kernels do not establish clean cutout alpha.
documentation_scope: Component sizes and precision glossary, published Base inference notebook, generalist examples and exhaustive comparisons; same tested model tensors and loader
